resources.title: How I'm Making 100–200 Divines PER HOUR rushing Citadels and Deadly Map Bosses 0.4
resources.creator: Byankuu
resources.noteEs: Byankuu documenta su loop de bossing en PoE 2 0.4: rushear Citadels y deadly map bosses para sostener 100-200 divines/hora. Incluye build requirements, ruta del Atlas, y cómo identificar maps con boss density alta. Boss-as-income, complementario al boss-as-progression.
resources.noteEn: Byankuu documents his PoE 2 0.4 bossing loop: rushing Citadels and deadly map bosses to sustain 100-200 divines/hour. Includes build requirements, Atlas route, and how to identify high boss-density maps. Boss-as-income, complementary to boss-as-progression.

resources.title: Abyss Quick Guide & How To Unlock All 8 Atlas Skill Points | 0.4.0
resources.creator: Blu Phoenix
resources.noteEs: Para acceder a los pinnacle bosses hay que primero desbloquear los Atlas Skill Points peleando Abyss y otros mecánicos. Blu Phoenix cubre cómo unlockear los 8 points completos con efficiency, qué bosses farmear primero, y cómo evitar los bottlenecks típicos. Pre-requisite obligatorio antes del bossing endgame.
resources.noteEn: To access pinnacle bosses, you first need to unlock Atlas Skill Points by fighting Abyss and other mechanics. Blu Phoenix covers how to efficiently unlock all 8 points, which bosses to farm first, and how to avoid typical bottlenecks. Mandatory prerequisite before endgame bossing.

resources.title: COMO MATAR AL ARBITER OF THE ASH
resources.creator: BuBahz
resources.noteEs: Anchor en español para el pinnacle boss: Arbiter of the Ash. BuBahz cubre las mecánicas, posicionamiento, y errores típicos que matan el run. Aunque es de finales de 2024 (launch del juego), las mecánicas core del boss siguen siendo iguales — la guía vale para 0.4 actual.
resources.noteEn: Spanish anchor for the pinnacle boss: Arbiter of the Ash. BuBahz covers mechanics, positioning, and typical mistakes that kill runs. Although from late 2024 (game launch), the boss's core mechanics remain the same — the guide is still valid for current 0.4.
